full_prompt_en: A square impressionistic landscape oil painting shows a narrow pale path winding through open green and golden meadow toward low rolling hills beneath a hazy blue-gray sky. The path begins wide at the lower edge near the center and curves left around a patch of dark grass before narrowing into the middle distance. Small white flower-like flecks scatter beside it, especially across the shadowed green foreground. A rounded gray boulder anchors the lower-left corner, while another pale stone sits farther back near the left side. The meadow is painted as a patchwork of short green, ocher, cream, and muted orange strokes, with soft boundaries between sunlit and shaded areas. On the right of center, a leafy green tree with several slim trunks stands beside a low rounded rock. Its canopy has a loose speckled edge and reaches toward the top of the frame, though the form remains airy enough for light to pass through. Smaller isolated trees punctuate the valley and the far slope. Beyond them, a broad hill rises on the left in bands of warm gold and olive, crossed by a few pale exposed patches. A darker belt of vegetation and a tiny light structure appear at the distant center, softened by atmosphere. The upper strip of sky carries small cream clouds set within washed blue and lavender gray. Clear daylight from the upper left brightens the meadow and pale path, while tree bases and foreground grass deepen into gentle cool shadow. The brushwork remains visible throughout: short broken marks articulate vegetation, smoother strokes describe the sky, and thicker pale touches pick out rocks and the path. No people or legible text interrupt the pastoral view. The overall composition uses the curving path and scattered tree masses to guide the eye gently through a luminous, spacious field of seasonal color.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形印象派风景油画描绘一条浅色窄路穿过开阔的绿色与金色草地，通向朦胧蓝灰天空下低缓起伏的丘陵。小径从下边缘中央附近较宽处开始，绕过一片深色草地向左弯曲，随后收窄进入中景。细小的白色花点散落在路旁，尤其密集于带阴影的绿色前景。一个圆钝灰色巨石固定左下角，另一块浅色石头位于更远的左侧。草地以短促的绿色、赭黄、奶油色和低调橙色笔触拼成，阳光区和阴影区之间的边界柔和。中央偏右，一棵有数根纤细树干的绿叶树立在低矮圆石旁。树冠边缘松散而呈点状，向画面顶部延展，形体仍足够通透，让光从中穿过。更小的独立树木点缀山谷和远处坡面。其后，宽阔的山丘在左侧升起，形成暖金和橄榄色带，并穿插几片浅色裸露地面。远处中央有较深的植被带和一个很小的浅色结构，被空气透视柔化。上方窄条天空在洗淡的蓝色和薰衣草灰中浮着小片奶油色云。来自左上方的清亮日光照亮草地与浅色小径，树根和前景草丛则沉入温和的冷影。画中处处留有可见笔触：短碎笔迹刻画植物，较平滑的笔触描绘天空，厚一点的浅色落笔点出石头和道路。没有人物或可读文字打断田园景象。整体构图借弯曲小径和散落树丛，引导视线温和地穿过一片明亮、宽敞且带季节色彩的原野。
style_prompt_en: The painting has an open-air impressionist oil surface shaped by short broken marks rather than hard contours. Fresh greens, olive, golden ocher, pale cream, and muted orange mingle in closely spaced patches, so color variation makes form and seasonal light. Near areas carry more granular texture and little bright flecks, while distant passages merge into softer, cooler bands. Rounded masses remain light and porous at their edges, allowing the surrounding tones to breathe through them. Clear daylight produces broad warm zones with gentle cool shadows, without theatrical contrast. A low sinuous line leads from a detailed foreground into layered shallow rises and a thin atmospheric upper band. The overall effect is spacious, calm, and sun warmed, with visible brush rhythm supplying its sense of movement.
style_prompt_zh: 画面呈现户外印象派油画表面，主要由短碎笔迹而非硬轮廓塑造。清新的绿色、橄榄色、金赭色、浅奶油色和低调橙色在紧密色块间交融，由色彩变化建立形体和季节光感。近处具有更明显的颗粒肌理与细小亮点，远处则融合成更柔和、更冷的色带。圆润形体的边缘轻盈而通透，让周围色调从中透气。清亮日光形成大片温暖区域与柔和冷影，没有戏剧化的强反差。一条低位蜿蜒线从细节丰富的前景引向层叠浅坡和狭窄的大气色上带。整体效果宽敞、平静而被阳光烘暖，可见笔触的节奏提供流动感。
theme_en: A winding path through sunlit rolling meadow
theme_zh: 阳光下起伏草地中的弯曲小径
name: Willard Metcalf
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
